digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent clone / event store recovery
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot tickets clone, predating the A6-0b deployment, with no corresponding commits on refs/remotes/origin/tickets.

The first file (TICKET_DIGEST.json) is a superseded unsigned derived-cache residue; the authoritative branch contains seven committed digests for the same ticket with a later timestamp, making this stranded copy disposable.
The second file (CLAIM_ENRICH.json) is an expired queue entry with an expired lease and a later superseding claim and DONE event in the authoritative history.
Both stranded files must be verified for content hash and path presence before deletion to ensure no condition mismatch introduces data loss.

After recovery/disposal operations, the persistent clone must be confirmed clean with HEAD equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets, no untracked files, and no merge/rebase/stash state before A6-1 publication.
